rationale.intervention_reconstruction: The hypothesis specifies the same thermal aging treatments at ~600°C and ~750°C applied to the same AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA in as-cast state, matching the paper's intervention exactly.
rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis defines the same aging temperature window (approx. 550-750°C) where chemical ordering kinetics and phase boundary evolution are maximized, matching the paper's conditions.
rationale.mechanism_agreement: The hypothesis proposes a completely different mechanism (dislocation nucleation at vacancy clusters, Shockley partials, stacking faults, and strain-rate effects) instead of the paper's mechanism (L12 ordering, APBE, cross-slip restriction, jagged phase boundary stress concentration).
rationale.outcome_agreement: The hypothesis predicts the same non-monotonic ductile-brittle-ductile transition with minimum ductility at 600°C and recovery at 750°C, matching the paper's result.
